sentence_2_en: Tom has been eating too much pork.

sentence_1_it: I maiali condividono certe caratteristiche con gli esseri umani.
sentence_1_en: Pigs share certain characteristics with human beings.
sentence_2_it: Tutte le mele che cadono vengono mangiate dai maiali.
sentence_2_en: All of the apples that fall are eaten by the pigs.
